correctness.rationale: For even n>=4, perfect-matchable edge sets have the incompatibility-graph presentation. A reflection-fixed simplex is a union of edge orbits; signed augmented Lefschetz is -I(Q;-1), and the lone reduced H_{n/2-1} has dimension two. The even-axis quotient Q has an isolated vertex, giving trace 0. Odd-axis open-twin reductions leave a chain of k=n/2 triangles with state transfer (f_j,g_j)=(g_{j-1},-f_{j-1}) at z=-1. Its signed evaluations give trace 0 for n divisible by four and 2(-1)^((n-2)/4) for n=2 modulo four, exactly as claimed. Separate published rotation trace zero and square (-1)^(n/2-1) yield the dihedral-module/invariant corollary. Independently enumerated actual matchings and all down-closed faces for n=4,6,8,10: (7,82),(18,730),(47,6562),(123,59050); the two reflection trace values agree (0,0),(0,-2),(0,0),(0,2). Finite checks are not the all-width proof.
